_comment: Altitude envelope of a launch document (D1). Read by test/test_launch_envelope_parity.py and bebop_mission_control/src/lib/altitudeEnvelope.test.ts. Bounds in metres over the floor, inclusive. platform.takeoff_from_ground true, or a pad height of 0, is a launch from the floor; the pad height stays the physical pad. A refused field is the path the mission names in mission.launch_refused.
